title: A 16-team championship in three minutes
idea: speed demo with a visible stopwatch — the timer keeps people watching
hook: A 16-team championship. I am building it right now, on camera, timed.

shots.source: Face, close. Phone in hand, starting a stopwatch
shots.title: 16 TEAMS · TIMED
shots.voice: A sixteen team championship. I am going to build it right now, on camera. Starting the clock.

shots.title: STEP 1 — FORMAT
shots.voice: Football, and the format: groups plus knockout. That is how inter school competitions actually run.

shots.title: ALL 16 IN ONE PASTE
shots.voice: I paste the school list in as one block. Nothing typed in by hand.

shots.title: FIXTURES BUILT THEMSELVES
shots.voice: Fixtures are done. Twenty four group matches across the rounds, with the strongest teams kept apart at the start.

shots.title: TABLE UPDATES ITSELF
shots.voice: I enter a score and the table recalculates. Points, goal difference, recent form. I am not doing any of the maths.

shots.title: BRACKET FILLED ITSELF
shots.voice: Who advanced was decided by the rules, not by memory. The bracket filled itself with the winners.

shots.title: 3 MINUTES · FREE
shots.voice: Three minutes. From here I only enter scores. Everything else is calculated for me. Link in bio.

caption:
From an empty screen to a full 16-team bracket in three minutes, timed on camera.

Every step shown: format, teams, fixtures, table, knockout. No manual arithmetic anywhere.

How long does this take you?
